device_entry.name: 网络摄像机
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
device_entry.description: 网络摄像机是一种通过以太网或局域网输出视频流的成像设备，可用于实验过程远程观察、样品与装置状态监控、图像记录以及实时帧采集。
device_entry.description_en: An IP camera is an imaging device that streams video over Ethernet or a local network. In laboratories it is used for remote observation of experiments, monitoring samples and instruments, recording visual status, and acquiring live image frames.
